A.note: RdRp. CMNV 1043 aa stated in PMID 32659308; MrNV 1045 and PvNV 1033 are RefSeq CDS lengths, the MrNV paper PMID 23318596 reporting only a 1034 aa partial

B2.note: Overlapping-frame ORF at the 3' end of protein A. MrNV 133 (PMID 23318596), CMNV 132 (PMID 32659308), PvNV 131 (RefSeq-only). NO subgenomic RNA has been demonstrated for any of these three viruses, and RNAi-suppressor activity has NOT been shown for any of them, so the product is annotated B2 protein and no function is claimed

CP.note: Capsid protein, a single UNCLEAVED chain with no gamma peptide (PMID 30346944; virion capsid is one 43 kDa polypeptide, PMID 15660790). GENUINELY BIMODAL BY SPECIES: MrNV 371 (PMIDs 23318596, 30346944), PvNV 368 (RefSeq-only), CMNV 437 (PMID 32659308). The Arg26 cut reported in PMID 34445426 is an E. coli cysteine-protease artefact of recombinant expression, blocked by E-64, and is not modelled
